rb_intro: 🤖 Your own sales bot Sell the plans under your own name and prices. Buyers pay to your card, and each sale takes your reseller price from your wallet. Making the bot: 1. Open @BotFather and send /newbot. 2. Give it a name and a username ending in bot. 3. Copy the token it gives you. 4. Tap «Connect bot» and send the token. The bot starts selling at once.
rb_blocked: ⛔️ The shop stopped your sales bot. Talk to support to start it again.
rb_needs_prepaid: A sales bot needs prepaid billing; your account is billed by usage. Ask the shop to change it.
rb_no_cards_warning: ⚠️ No card yet, so buyers can't pay. Add one under «Cards».
rb_not_allowed: Sales bots aren't turned on for you.
rb_ask_token: Send the token of the bot you made with @BotFather (like 123456789:AAH...). Your message is deleted once read.
rb_err_bot_token_invalid: ❌ That token isn't valid. Copy it again from @BotFather and send it.
rb_err_bot_token_is_main: ❌ That is the main bot's own token. Make a new bot.
rb_err_bot_token_in_use: ❌ That bot is already registered to someone else.
rb_err_reseller_bot_blocked: ⛔️ The shop stopped your sales bot.
rb_connected: ✅ @{bot} is connected and selling from now on.
rb_not_connected: You haven't connected a bot yet.
rb_ask_markup:
What markup on your own price, in percent? (now {now}%, 0 to 500)
Plans with a fixed price ignore it.
rb_ask_support: Send the bot's support username, like @my_support. Now: {now} Send «-» to clear it.
rb_ask_card: Send the card number (or IBAN) and the holder's name in one message, e.g.: 6037991234567890 Sara Ahmadi
rb_support_invalid: That username doesn't look right; send it like @my_support.
rb_cards_title: 💳 Your bot's cards Buyers pay to these cards and you approve the receipts in your own bot.
rb_card_invalid: That card number isn't right. Send the 16 card digits (or a full IBAN), then the holder's name.
rb_cards_full: You can't add more than 20 cards.
rb_prices_title: 💰 Plan prices in your bot Tap a plan to set a fixed price. 📌 marks a fixed price; the rest follow your markup.
rb_delete_confirm: Stop and disconnect @{bot}? Its customers and their services stay and come back when you connect again.
rb_ready_notice:
🎉 Your sales bot (@{bot}) is live!
Set its cards, prices and support under «Reseller → 🤖 My sales bot».
adm_rbot_ask_token:
Send the reseller's bot token (from @BotFather). The bot goes live for them at once.
Your message is deleted once read.
adm_user_btn_hide: ❌ Hide a panel for the user
adm_hide_title: 🙈 Panels hidden from {name} Tap a panel to hide or show it for this user. A hidden panel's plans can't be seen or bought (in the reseller's own bot too).
adm_trial_not_used: This user hasn't taken a trial yet and can take one now.
adm_trial_again_done: ✅ This user can take one more trial.
adm_trial_reset_confirm: Reset every user's trial? Each user can then take one more trial.
adm_trial_reset_done: ✅ Trials reset; everyone can take one again.
ask_username: Send a username for your service: 3 to 16 lowercase English letters, digits or _ (starting with a letter). Send «-» to have one made for you.
username_invalid: That name won't work. Use lowercase English letters, digits and _, 3 to 16 characters, starting with a letter.
username_saved: ✅ Service name: {name} If it's taken on the server, a few characters are added at the end.
username_skipped: The service name will be made for you ✅
all_links_header: 📋 Links of all your services ({count}) — tap a link to copy it:
all_links_file: 📋 The links of all your services ({count}) are in this file.
all_configs_caption: 📄 Configs of {count} services in one file. Each line can be imported into your app.
adm_ticket_noted: 📝 Internal note saved; nothing was sent to the customer.
adm_ticket_note_ask: Send the internal note for ticket #{id} (the customer won't see it):
adm_ticket_canned_pick: ⚡️ Pick a canned reply for ticket #{id}:
ticket_ask_department: 🗂 Which department is your ticket for?
ticket_note_staff_only: Internal notes are for staff only.
ticket_department_unknown: That department is no longer available; please open a new ticket.
adm_ticket_take_no_account: You need a staff account in the panel to take tickets.
payment_intent_conflict: This payment request changed. Check the amount and method before trying again.
payment_intent_closed: This payment request is closed or expired. Try again to start a new payment.
national_no_replacement: National-network mode is active. Renew to receive a replacement configuration.
national_service_notice: National-network mode is active. Statistics above describe the original service. Renewal delivers a replacement; retrieve its files from your ready-made configurations.
national_checkout_notice: Delivery uses national-network inventory. Renewal provides a new replacement configuration, without changing the original panel subscription’s quota or expiry.
trial_phone_used: This phone number has already had a free trial.
trial_too_new: Your account is brand new; try the free trial again a little later.
adm_ticket_service_down: ⚠️ This service's panel cannot be reached right now; the numbers are from the last sync.
adm_ticket_service_stored: ℹ️ The numbers are from the last sync.
service_busy: This service is being changed right now (a renewal, for example). Try again in a few seconds.
